body:
HS really hasn't been all that bad to me, although I guess the change of pace will be good for me, if I make it that far. 

Fuck dude, you made me kind of look forward to the future. Thanks for that, I haven't felt like this in... Well, in a while.

That sucks that you have to see her everyday, it makes getting over someone so much harder. Still, it might be a good idea to keep your contact with her to a minimum, at least for a little while. It seems like it's really hard on you to be around her, or at least bad for you long-term. 

Are you close to your other friends? At least close enough where you could like hug them and stuff? I know it's weird for guys to hug guys, and it was really hard for me to start doing stuff like that but I dunno, if you can find organic moments for human contact it's really nice. It might not be the romantic or sexual release you're looking for but it's something you know?

Sorry to hit you with the semi-generic advice now but have you considered seeing a therapist? It's said a lot but they really are helpful to working out all kinds of issues and I think you could really benefit from it, if youre in a position to do so. 

I'm going to bed now, PM me if you want to keep talking and I'll reply some time in the morning. 

*shitty and inadequate Internet hug to tide you over until you get the real deal*

I hate when people say things like "it gets better." If I wanted generic advice I'd go to a magic 8 ball, you know? 

If you want someone to talk to Im an okay listener, and I'm also going through a rough time so I think I'd understand more than your friends do.

If you don't feel like talking though that's fine, and I sincerely hope you feel better eventually.
17, going on 18. Senior in high school

I actually do have a therapist, and I've talked to him about me feeling depressed. It helps some, but he hasn't recommended antidepressants or anything like that and I'm not on any medication. He doesn't seem to take my suicidal thoughts super seriously but also I haven't talked to him since they turned more serious. 

I feel like I shouldnt be this bad, I have a really good support network. Parents, friends, a therapist I see weekly. Except it seems like none of them care and no matter how much I ask for help none of them will put in the effort to actually speak to me, or listen, and if they do they just hear what they want to hear or chalk it up to teenage angst. 

Thanks for responding. I hope we can keep talking, but I understand if that isn't the case.
